intro: I'm Sachin Raj. I build robotic systems and I validate them — the same person doing both, on purpose.

My background is mechanical engineering. I've spent years working in environments where data pipelines feed directly into high-stakes decisions, and where a silent processing error is the worst kind. That work taught me how to prove a system is correct — not just that it runs, but that it produces what it claims to produce, reproducibly, with a documentation trail that survives scrutiny.
I'm now applying that same standard to physical systems I build myself. Robots, hydraulic arms, sensor pipelines. The methodology transfers. The stakes change.
Papers and build logs are open. Tools link to GitHub and PyPI. Leave a note if you want to connect.

contact.note: Open to research collaboration, technical questions about the tools or papers, and conversations with engineers working on robotic systems and validation methodology.
